rules.statement: When equipment is bodyweight/home-only, never prescribe a barbell, dumbbell-rack, cable-machine, or Smith-machine movement — substitute the bodyweight or household-object equivalent.
rules.rationale: A user without gym equipment cannot safely or physically perform a loaded-barbell movement — a hard usability/safety mismatch, not a style preference.

rules.statement: Do not prescribe HIIT-style movements (burpees, jump squats, mountain climbers, sprint intervals, box jumps) during Menstrual phase even at Moderate intensity — cortisol/CNS load should stay low; use steady mobility/strength instead.
rules.rationale: High-intensity interval work spikes cortisol and CNS fatigue, compounding the already-elevated inflammatory/low-energy state of menstruation.

rules.statement: If the user has logged an injury/limitation (e.g. 'knee pain', 'lower back issue'), never prescribe a movement that directly loads that joint — always give the safer swap explicitly.
rules.rationale: Direct safety requirement — a model could otherwise slip in a banned movement even when told about the injury in prose.
rules._detectionNote: terms computed dynamically per-request from the injury->movement keyword map in rules-loader.ts (getInjuryContraindicationTerms), not statically listed here.

rules.statement: If PMS symptoms (bloating, irritability, fatigue, cramps) are present in late Luteal phase, prefer Pilates/LISS/yoga-style movement and avoid heavy compound lifts (deadlift, back squat) even at Moderate energy.
rules.rationale: Progesterone-driven core body temperature rise plus PMS fatigue reduces safe performance capacity for maximal loaded lifts late in the Luteal phase.

rules.statement: During Ovulatory phase, every main_set exercise's notes must include an explicit joint-protection/form cue — ligament laxity is elevated from peak estrogen/testosterone.
rules._enforcement: Already enforced by the Ovulatory-notes-keyword check in evaluateCoachQuality — documentation only, no detection block here.

rules.statement: Menstrual-phase intensity must never be High regardless of requested energy level — cap at Moderate even on a self-reported high-energy day.
rules._enforcement: Already enforced by the Menstrual+High intensity check in evaluateCoachQuality — documentation only, no detection block here.

rules.statement: Warmup must be exactly 3 items and cooldown exactly 3 items; main_set must be 4-6 items.
rules._enforcement: Structurally requested in the exercise_coach prompt; array-length hard-check is optional future hardening, not part of this feature.
